purpose: Isolate the effect of standing-to-roll target projection and slew. Use the frozen roll policy and original penetration, support, completion and landing gates.

branches.original-roll-target: Use archived roll policy HOME plus original raw output at the boundary, as in the independently accepted standalone simulator. Retain the physical joint-envelope and head-contact monitors.
branches.projection-only: Project the same raw roll target into the absolute joint envelope. Keep the original policy history and do not add an entry slew.
branches.projection-and-slew: Project the target, then apply the previous 2 rad/s entry limit for 25 controls. The only difference from projection-only is entry slew.

required_preflight: Restore the exact complete k=50 state, CPU and GPU RNG, model fields, actuator rings, sensor state and observation history between branches
Compare actual boundary joint inputs and the first delayed motor command in the same plant
Freeze the stop logic and store first failure event time and penetration cause before any active control
Verify the Windows observation page and camera
Keep the original 5 mm head penetration threshold and 116/128 roll threshold
stop_rule: When the maximum possible number of original valid rolls falls below 116, close that branch as failed and preserve its acquired first-episode evidence. No budget extension or retry.
scope: Development only. A passing branch requires independent continuous stand, roll, stand and 20 s forward, followed by the remaining transition and robustness stages.
